The garments cling like a second skin and show real material behaviour: the thin stretch velvet molded so closely that it shows the soft relief of her collarbones, her hip bones and the gentle rise of her bust and hips, the crescent-moon clasp, the small silver stars and the sharp clean edges of the diamond cutout, a soft velvet pile that shifts from deep purple to near black in the folds. Jewelry is metal and pearl only, worn on the body, nothing added to her face or ears.

ONE woman only. Full-length wide shot from a moderate distance with the camera at waist height, the whole figure from the soles of the boots to the top of her head completely visible, with the door, railing or steps beside her at normal human scale so the extreme heel height reads at a glance, the towering heels clearly separating the boot soles from the floor.
